new_lines: version: 20.0.0

ScheduledRssCondition:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - field
        - operator
      properties:
        field:
          type: string
          enum:
            - title
            - summary
            - content
            - author
            - category
            - link
            - domain
        operator:
          type: string
          enum:
            - contains
            - not_contains
            - equals
            - not_equals
            - starts_with
            - not_starts_with
            - ends_with
            - not_ends_with
            - is_empty
            - is_not_empty
        value:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 1024
          description: At most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, additionally enforced by parseRssConditions. JSON Schema maxLength counts characters, not bytes.
      oneOf:
        - properties:
            operator:
              enum:
                - contains
                - not_contains
                - equals
                - not_equals
                - starts_with
                - not_starts_with
                - ends_with
                - not_ends_with
          required:
            - value
        - properties:
            operator:
              enum:
                - is_empty
                - is_not_empty
          not:
            anyOf:
              - required:
                  - value
    ScheduledRssConditions:
      type: array
      maxItems: 8
      description: OR groups of AND rules. Empty outer array means no filtering. Regex/date/numeric rules are unsupported and rejected.
      items:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        maxItems: 16
        items:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ScheduledRssCondition'
    ScheduledRssErrorCode:
      type:
        - string
        - 'null'
      enum:
        - null
        - rss_feed_url_invalid
        - rss_feed_address_forbidden
        - rss_feed_dns_unavailable
        - rss_feed_dns_busy
        - rss_feed_unavailable
        - rss_feed_timeout
        - rss_feed_cancelled
        - rss_feed_response_invalid
        - rss_feed_too_large
        - feed_invalid
        - queue_full
        - launch_too_large
        - limit_reached
- trigger_kind

type:
            - string
            - 'null'

trigger_kind:
          type: string
          enum:
            - calendar
            - rss
        observed_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: Actual DB observation instant for an RSS item, not publisher time or the logical internal queue order key.
      oneOf:
        - properties:
            trigger_kind:
              const: calendar
            scheduled_for:
              type: string
              format: date-time
              pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]{9}Z$
          not:
            anyOf:
              - required:
                  - observed_at
        - properties:
            trigger_kind:
              const: rss
            scheduled_for:
              type: 'null'
          required:
            - observed_at
